summary: The note describes Ensign Manufacturing Company, a railroad car manufacturer based in Huntington, West Virginia, founded in 1872 as Ensign Car Works. During the 1880s and 1890s its wood freight car production made it one of the three largest sawmill operators in Cabell County. In 1899 Ensign was merged with twelve other companies to form American Car and Foundry Company.
one_line: Ensign Manufacturing Company was a Huntington, West Virginia railroad car maker that merged into American Car and Foundry in 1899.
